capabilities: Collect and navigate highlights in ==, <mark>, <span>, and custom regex formats from a sidebar
Add comments and file-level comments to highlighted text
Generate AI comments using configurable prompts and providers
Export highlights and comments as knowledge-card images or as new notes with block references
Create and review flashcards with the FSRS spaced repetition algorithm (Pro)
extras: Freemium: the flashcard system requires a Pro license, rechecked online every seven days with a 30-day offline grace period. The README warns the plugin is in Beta and advises backing up data regularly; video tutorials are linked externally.
problem: Obsidian stores highlights as inline markup with no built-in way to collect them, attach comments, or review them across the vault.

relations.evidence: Currently supported providers include OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, Deepseek, SiliconFlow, and Ollama.
